approval.statusSemantics: The approved Markdown is an immutable pre-approval draft snapshot. Its DRAFT/PENDING prose records state at authoring time; this external manifest plus Beads write/readback is the approval authority and supersedes only lifecycle status, not product content.

deliveryGate.candidateShaAuthority: Bound from the Delivery Unit commit and recorded in delivery evidence before the actual Pi Git-package gate; it is not an approval-time product input.
requirements: temporary Pi settings must omit npmCommand so Pi uses npm install --omit=dev
no SSH source, credential helper, provider credential, or user-global package fallback
install npm:pi-subagents in the same isolated configuration before agent discovery assertions

taskStageGates.T1: npm run test:v1 && npm run typecheck:v1 && git diff --check
taskStageGates.T2: npm run test:v1 && npm run typecheck:v1 && npm run build:v2 && git diff --check
taskStageGates.T3: npm run test:v1 && npm run test:v2 && npm run typecheck && npm run build:v2 && node scripts/validate-v2-boundaries.mjs && git diff --check
taskStageGates.T4: npm run check && node scripts/test-v2-package-compat.mjs --candidate "$PWD" --mode clone-parity && git diff --check
taskStageGates.T5: npm ci && npm run check && node scripts/validate-v2-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/test-v2-package-compat.mjs --candidate "$PWD" --mode clone-parity && git diff --check

verificationContract.workflowVerifyCommand: npm ci && npm run check && node scripts/validate-v2-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/test-v2-package-compat.mjs --candidate "$PWD" --mode clone-parity && git diff --check

governance.note: Bootstrap bundle used before E25 Document Bundle implementation; no production credential or runtime authority.

toolchainPolicy.driftRule: Major-version or package-install semantic drift requires readiness re-evaluation; observed patch drift is recorded in verification evidence.

bootstrapExecution.reason: E15/E16 managed mirror/worktree capability does not exist yet; bootstrap control is deterministic and limited to E01.
requirements: Create branch v2/e01-workspace-boundaries from a recorded frozen base SHA.
Create one isolated git worktree outside the user checkout; the user checkout is never an E01 writer.
Install the exact approved bundle into the worktree and verify PRD/manifest hashes before any implementation claim.
Create a governance baseline commit containing the approved Initiative/E01 documents before Dev starts, so the implementation baseline is clean and attributable.
Run wfpi from the isolated worktree and bind E01 repo/cwd to that worktree; one Dev writer only.
The bootstrap manager may create/remove the branch/worktree and verify hashes but may not implement E01 code.
Unknown dirty state, hash drift, or branch/worktree reuse fails closed.
bootstrapExecution.sunset: This bootstrap mode is retired after E16 provides managed worktrees.
